tag: 週三收盤：納指領漲 1.05%、小型股只漲 0.16%
zh: 週三（10/21）美股收高：道瓊上漲約 0.69% 至 52,862.30，標普 500 上漲約 0.59% 至 7,757.72，那斯達克上漲約 1.05% 至 26,702.86，那斯達克 100 上漲約 1.13%，羅素 2000 只漲約 0.16% 至 2,781.03。科技與 AI 基礎設施領漲，小型股明顯落後。收盤後 Meta、IBM、特斯拉、德州儀器與 Lam Research 陸續公布財報。各來源數字略有出入，正式收盤價請以交易所公布為準。
en: US stocks closed higher on Wednesday Oct. 21: the Dow rose about 0.69% to 52,862.30, the S&P 500 gained about 0.59% to 7,757.72, the Nasdaq added about 1.05% to 26,702.86, the Nasdaq 100 rose about 1.13% and the Russell 2000 gained only about 0.16% to 2,781.03. Tech and AI infrastructure led while small caps lagged. Meta, IBM, Tesla, Texas Instruments and Lam Research reported after the close. Sources differ slightly; use official exchange closes as the reference.

stocks.n: 標普 500 ETF，週三約 +0.59%
那斯達克 100 ETF，指數約 +1.13%，領漲
羅素 2000 ETF，指數只漲約 0.16%
道瓊 ETF，指數約 +0.69%

tag: AI 硬體齊漲、串流與電信下挫
zh: 個股兩極：Super Micro 大漲約 9.55% 至 35.57 美元，原因是把本季初步營收預估上調到 185 億至 195 億美元（先前為 145 億至 155 億美元）；戴爾漲約 5.27%、Vertiv 漲約 4.26%、GE Vernova 漲約 4.03%。另一邊 Netflix 因第四季財測偏弱、廣告收入展望下修，下跌約 5.31% 至 65.05 美元；AT&T 跌約 6.45%、惠而浦跌約 5.35%、Chipotle 跌約 5.26%。
en: Single stocks split. Super Micro jumped about 9.55% to $35.57 after raising its preliminary quarterly revenue outlook to $18.5 billion-$19.5 billion from $14.5 billion-$15.5 billion; Dell rose about 5.27%, Vertiv 4.26% and GE Vernova 4.03%. On the other side Netflix fell about 5.31% to $65.05 on weaker fourth-quarter guidance and a lower ad outlook; AT&T dropped about 6.45%, Whirlpool 5.35% and Chipotle 5.26%.

stocks.n: Super Micro，上調本季營收預估，約 +9.55%
戴爾，AI 伺服器需求，約 +5.27%
Netflix，財測偏弱，約 -5.31%
惠而浦，家電，約 -5.35%
Chipotle，餐飲，約 -5.26%

tag: 商品與加密：油價高檔震盪、比特幣反彈
zh: 油價在美伊談判與荷莫茲海峽相關消息間來回震盪，WTI 收在約 97 至 99 美元（各來源略有出入）；美國原油庫存減少 306 萬桶，大於預期的 82 萬桶。黃金約 4,134 美元、白銀約 57.86 美元、銅約 6.57 美元。比特幣上漲約 1.8% 至約 84,543 美元，持有比特幣的 Strategy 股價大漲約 7.54%。
en: Oil swung between US-Iran talks headlines and Gulf shipping concerns, with WTI ending around $97-$99 depending on the source; US crude inventories fell by 3.06 million barrels versus an expected 0.82 million draw. Gold was about $4,134, silver about $57.86 and copper about $6.57. Bitcoin rose about 1.8% to roughly $84,543, and Strategy, which holds bitcoin, jumped about 7.54%.

stocks.n: 原油 ETF，油價約 97 至 99 美元高檔震盪
黃金 ETF，金價約 4,134 美元
Strategy，比特幣反彈，約 +7.54%
銅礦 ETF，銅價約 6.57 美元，小跌

tag: 盤勢結構：科技領漲、小型股掉隊
zh: 週三那斯達克 100 漲約 1.13%，羅素 2000 只漲約 0.16%，差距明顯。報導指出羅素 2000 在 10/14 因通膨數據偏熱單日重挫約 2.2%，一度從 8 月高點回檔超過 10%；小型股對利率特別敏感，因為約 29% 的債務是浮動利率（標普 500 約 7%）。這解釋了為什麼資金在殖利率高檔時偏好大型科技。
en: On Wednesday the Nasdaq 100 gained about 1.13% against only about 0.16% for the Russell 2000, a wide gap. Reports say the Russell 2000 fell about 2.2% in one day on Oct. 14 after hot inflation data and at one point sat more than 10% below its August peak; small caps are rate-sensitive because roughly 29% of their debt is floating-rate versus about 7% for the S&P 500. That helps explain why money prefers large-cap tech while yields are high.

stocks.n: 羅素 2000 ETF，相對大型股落後
標普小型 600 ETF，利率敏感度高
那斯達克 100 ETF，資金偏好的一端

tag: Meta：營收優於預期，GAAP 因訴訟費用失準
zh: Meta 第三季營收 646 億美元，高於預期的 633.1 億美元；依公認會計原則的每股盈餘 3.83 美元低於預期，是因為一筆訴訟相關費用，剔除後為 7.40 美元，高於預期的 6.67 美元。盤後股價上漲約 4%。看點是明天起的資本支出與 AI 投資預測，這決定市場把這次上漲視為「廣告撐住」還是「花費失控」。
en: Meta reported third-quarter revenue of $64.6 billion versus $63.31 billion expected. GAAP EPS of $3.83 missed because of a litigation-related charge; excluding it, EPS was $7.40 versus $6.67 expected. Shares rose about 4% after hours. The focus now is capital spending and AI investment guidance, which decide whether the move is read as ads holding up or spending running away.

stocks.n: Meta，營收 646 億美元，盤後約 +4%

tag: IBM 與 SAP：企業軟體財報雙雙優於預期
zh: IBM 調整後每股盈餘 2.95 美元、營收 171 億美元，皆高於預期（2.86 美元、168.1 億美元），全年營收展望維持、自由現金流展望上調，盤後約漲 4.6%。德國軟體商 SAP 營收 103 億歐元、調整後營業利益 30 億歐元，全年財測高於市場共識，股價約漲 4%。兩家同時出好成績，緩和了「AI 吃掉傳統企業軟體」的擔憂。
en: IBM posted adjusted EPS of $2.95 and revenue of $17.1 billion, both above expectations of $2.86 and $16.81 billion; it kept full-year revenue guidance and raised its free cash flow outlook, and shares rose about 4.6% after hours. SAP reported revenue of 10.3 billion euros and adjusted operating profit of 3.0 billion euros, with full-year guidance above consensus, and rose about 4%. Two solid reports at once ease worries that AI is eating traditional enterprise software.

stocks.n: IBM，財報優於預期，盤後約 +4.6%
SAP，全年財測高於共識，約 +4%

tag: Lam Research 優於預期卻大跌，特斯拉營收小幅落後
zh: Lam Research 調整後每股盈餘 2.20 美元、營收 82.2 億美元，高於預期，但盤後下跌約 6%，顯示市場要的是更強的訂單與展望。特斯拉調整後每股盈餘 0.48 美元高於預期的 0.45 美元，營收 280 億美元略低於預期的 281 億美元，盤後約漲 1.2%。德州儀器每股盈餘 2.62 美元、營收 60.6 億美元皆優於預期，下季財測高於預期，盤後約漲 0.65%。
en: Lam Research posted adjusted EPS of $2.20 and revenue of $8.22 billion, above estimates, yet fell about 6% after hours, showing the market wanted stronger orders and outlook. Tesla's adjusted EPS of $0.48 beat $0.45 while revenue of $28.0 billion was a hair below the $28.1 billion expected, and shares rose about 1.2%. Texas Instruments earned $2.62 on $6.06 billion of revenue, both above estimates, with next-quarter guidance above expectations, and rose about 0.65%.

stocks.n: Lam Research，優於預期仍盤後約 -6%
特斯拉，EPS 優於預期、營收略低，約 +1.2%
德州儀器，下季財測高於預期，約 +0.65%

tag: 殖利率曲線趨平、二十年期標售需要讓價
zh: 週三殖利率：二年期約 4.80%、五年期約 4.95%、十年期約 5.12%、三十年期約 5.41%，曲線小幅趨平。130 億美元的二十年期公債標售得標殖利率約 5.469%，需要一些讓價才賣得出去，但整體需求尚可。長天期殖利率停在 5% 以上，是壓住小型股與房貸利率敏感族群的主要原因。
en: Wednesday's yields: two-year about 4.80%, five-year about 4.95%, ten-year about 5.12% and thirty-year about 5.41%, with the curve flattening slightly. The $13 billion 20-year auction cleared at about 5.469% and needed a concession, though overall demand was reasonable. Long-dated yields above 5% remain the main weight on small caps and rate-sensitive groups such as housing.

stocks.n: 20 年期以上公債 ETF，長債殖利率 5% 以上
7-10 年期公債 ETF
房屋建築 ETF，對長天期利率敏感

tag: 油價與中東：談判與衝突風險並存
zh: 美國國務院據報正準備讓海灣地區部分大使館人員撤離，理由是葉門伊朗結盟民兵可能再度開戰；同時卡達與巴基斯坦提出折衷方案，但有人反駁美伊協議即將達成的說法。這些消息讓 WTI 在約 97 至 99 美元之間來回。對通膨預期來說，油價高檔延續的時間比單日漲跌重要。報導同時提到俄烏三方會談的前景重新出現。
en: The State Department is reportedly preparing ordered departures at some Gulf embassies over the risk of renewed fighting involving Iran-aligned militias in Yemen, while a Qatar-Pakistan compromise proposal drew pushback against talk of an imminent US-Iran deal. That kept WTI bouncing around $97-$99. For inflation expectations, how long oil stays high matters more than any single day's move. Prospects for three-way Russia-Ukraine talks also resurfaced.

stocks.n: 能源類股 ETF，受油價高檔支撐
西方石油，油價敏感的上游生產商
航太與國防 ETF，地緣風險受惠族群

tag: 歐洲：法國殖利率創 2002 年來新高、澳洲央行鷹派
zh: 歐股收高，德國 DAX 漲約 1.35%、法國 CAC 漲約 1.06%，但法國公債殖利率卻升到 2002 年以來最高，顯示股市與債市對財政風險的看法不一致。外匯方面，澳幣在澳洲央行官員鷹派談話後上漲約 0.35% 至 0.41%，領先主要貨幣，美元指數大致持平在 101.7 附近。
en: European equities closed higher, with the DAX up about 1.35% and the CAC up about 1.06%, yet French government bond yields rose to their highest since 2002, a sign that stocks and bonds disagree about fiscal risk. In FX the Australian dollar gained roughly 0.35%-0.41% after a hawkish Reserve Bank of Australia speech, leading the majors, while the Dollar Index was flat near 101.7.

stocks.n: 德國 ETF，DAX 約 +1.35%
法國 ETF，CAC 約 +1.06%，但國債殖利率偏高
澳幣 ETF，澳洲央行鷹派後走強

tag: AI 基礎設施：伺服器、散熱、電力設備一起走強
zh: AI 資料中心鏈全線上揚：伺服器廠 Super Micro 與戴爾領漲，液冷與電力設備商 Vertiv 約漲 4.26%、GE Vernova 約漲 4.03%。Super Micro 的上調預告等於再次確認 AI 伺服器出貨在加速，但盤後 Lam Research 優於預期仍下跌，提醒市場對「晶片設備」要求更高。這條鏈上的族群內部已有分化，不是全面齊漲。
en: The AI data-center chain rose across the board: server makers Super Micro and Dell led, while cooling and power equipment makers Vertiv gained about 4.26% and GE Vernova about 4.03%. Super Micro's raised preview again confirms that AI server shipments are accelerating, yet Lam Research fell after hours despite a beat, a reminder that chip equipment faces a higher bar. The group is already diverging internally rather than rising together.

stocks.n: Vertiv，資料中心散熱與電力，約 +4.26%
GE Vernova，電力設備，約 +4.03%
Super Micro，本季營收預估上調

tag: 軟體與資安反彈、消費與電信走弱
zh: 軟體族群反彈：Datadog 約漲 6.5%、CrowdStrike 約漲 5.26%、Palantir 約漲 4.72%，加上 IBM、SAP 盤後財報良好，軟體的壓力暫時減輕。反觀消費與防禦族群走弱，AT&T 下跌約 6.45%、Chipotle 下跌約 5.26%、惠而浦下跌約 5.35%。資金在比較「AI 受惠」與「利率與消費壓力」兩端，輪動的方向偏向前者。
en: Software rebounded: Datadog gained about 6.5%, CrowdStrike about 5.26% and Palantir about 4.72%, and good IBM and SAP reports after the close eased the pressure for now. Consumer and defensive names weakened, with AT&T down about 6.45%, Chipotle about 5.26% and Whirlpool about 5.35%. Money is weighing AI beneficiaries against rate and consumer pressure, and rotation favored the former.

stocks.n: Datadog，監控軟體，約 +6.5%
CrowdStrike，資安，約 +5.26%
Palantir，約 +4.72%

tag: 加密資產與相關股：比特幣約 8.45 萬美元
zh: 比特幣上漲約 1.8% 至約 84,543 美元，持有大量比特幣的 Strategy 股價大漲約 7.54%，放大了加密貨幣的槓桿效果。這類股票的股價會隨比特幣漲跌放大，而且本身的財務結構（舉債、發行新股買幣）與一般企業不同，判讀時要把「幣價」與「公司財務」分開看。
en: Bitcoin rose about 1.8% to roughly $84,543, and Strategy, which holds a large bitcoin treasury, jumped about 7.54%, showing the leverage in crypto-linked equities. These stocks amplify bitcoin's moves and have a different financial structure (debt, new share issuance to buy coins) from ordinary companies, so judge bitcoin's price and the company's finances separately.

stocks.n: Strategy，持幣公司，約 +7.54%
比特幣現貨 ETF，隨幣價波動
Coinbase，加密交易所，與幣價連動

tag: 為什麼小型股怕高利率：浮動利率債務佔 29%
zh: 小型股對利率敏感，原因在資產負債表：羅素 2000 成分股約 29% 的債務是浮動利率，標普 500 只有約 7%，所以十年期殖利率停在 5% 以上時，利息支出會直接侵蝕獲利。報導也指出羅素 2000 對標普 500 的比值已降到 2025 年 11 月以來最低。判讀小型股時，先看負債結構與利息保障倍數，再看故事。
en: Small caps are rate-sensitive because of their balance sheets: roughly 29% of Russell 2000 debt is floating-rate versus about 7% for the S&P 500, so with the 10-year yield above 5% interest costs eat directly into earnings. Reports also say the Russell 2000 to S&P 500 ratio fell to its lowest since November 2025. When judging small caps, check debt structure and interest coverage before the story.

stocks.n: 羅素 2000 ETF，對利率敏感
標普小型 600 ETF，品質篩選較嚴
小型股 ETF，另一個廣度較大的小型股指標

tag: Exagen（XGN）：董事買、執行長賣的混合訊號
zh: 小型診斷公司 Exagen 的董事 Jorey Chernett 在 10/19 公開市場買進 14,000 股，約 10.4 萬美元（約每股 7.46 美元）；同一期間執行長有約 27 萬美元的賣出。內部人買賣同時出現，訊號是混合的：買進金額不大，賣出也可能只是計畫性或稅務需求。這張是用來示範「別只看一邊」，不代表任何方向。
en: At small-cap diagnostics firm Exagen, director Jorey Chernett bought 14,000 shares on the open market on Oct. 19 for about $104,000 (about $7.46 a share), while the chief executive sold roughly $270,000 over the same period. Buying and selling at once is a mixed signal: the purchase is small and the sale may be plan-driven or tax-related. This card shows why to avoid looking at only one side; it implies no direction.

stocks.n: Exagen，董事買進約 10.4 萬美元

tag: 微型股的小額買進：York Water 與 Saker Aviation
zh: York Water（YORW）有多位主管與董事近期買進，但金額都很小，最大一筆是董事 David Velazquez 約 4 萬美元，其餘多是幾百到幾千美元，很像定期投入而非看好某個轉折。Saker Aviation（SKAS）董事 10/20 買進 12,700 股約 7 萬美元。判讀微型股的內部人買進，重點是金額相對其薪酬與持股，以及是不是反覆出現。
en: At York Water several executives and directors bought recently, but the sizes are small: the largest is about $40,000 by director David Velazquez, while the rest run from a few hundred to a few thousand dollars, looking more like regular contributions than a bet on a turning point. A Saker Aviation director bought 12,700 shares on Oct. 20 for about $70,000. With micro caps, what matters is the size relative to the insider's pay and holdings, and whether buying repeats.

stocks.n: York Water，多位內部人小額買進
Saker Aviation，董事買進約 7 萬美元

tag: 社區銀行第三季：獲利成長但利差壓力不一
zh: 社區銀行陸續公布第三季：First Community（FCCO）淨利年增約 54.9% 至 804 萬美元、每股 0.85 美元；Community Trust（CTBI）每股 1.43 美元，去年同期 1.32 美元；Third Coast（TCBX）平均資產報酬率 1.13%，低於第二季的 1.34%。United Community（UCB）營運每股盈餘 0.77 美元，與預期相符。同樣是社區銀行，獲利動能差很多，要逐家看。
en: Community banks are reporting third quarter: First Community (FCCO) net income rose about 54.9% to $8.04 million, or $0.85 a share; Community Trust (CTBI) earned $1.43 a share versus $1.32 a year earlier; Third Coast (TCBX) return on average assets was 1.13% versus 1.34% in the second quarter. United Community (UCB) posted operating EPS of $0.77, in line with expectations. Earnings momentum differs a lot among community banks, so check them one by one.

stocks.n: First Community，淨利年增約 54.9%
Community Trust，EPS 1.43 美元
Third Coast，ROA 降至 1.13%
區域銀行 ETF，社區銀行的產業對照

tag: Mission Produce（AVO）：董事買進加上併購綜效上調
zh: Mission Produce 是酪梨進口與配銷商，5 月完成收購 Calavo。為什麼被忽視：冷門農產品供應鏈、整合期財報有雜訊（最近一季淨損 650 萬美元）。什麼正在改變：公司把 Calavo 年化成本綜效目標從至少 2,500 萬美元上調到超過 3,000 萬美元，預期自本財年第四季開始貢獻；董事 Luis Gonzalez 在 10/9 與 10/12 買進約 59.5 萬美元（間接持有），6 月也有董事買進。風險：整合成本、客戶流失與負債增加。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Mission Produce is an avocado importer and distributor that closed its Calavo acquisition in May. Why neglected: a niche agricultural supply chain and noisy integration-period results (a $6.5 million net loss last quarter). What is changing: it raised the annualized Calavo cost synergy target from at least $25 million to more than $30 million, expected to start contributing in fiscal Q4, and director Luis Gonzalez bought about $595,000 on Oct. 9 and 12 (indirect), following director purchases in June. Risks: integration costs, customer churn and added debt. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

stocks.n: Mission Produce，董事買進、綜效目標上調

status: RADAR · 下一個驗證點 10 月投資人日與約 12 月財報

tag: MSG Rangers（MSGR）：分拆預計 10/26 完成
zh: MSG Sports 分拆遊騎兵業務，據 8-K，分拆預計 10/26 完成，預發行交易自 10/21 開始，正式交易預計 10/27。留下的 MSG Sports 預計改名為 MSG Knicks，新分出的公司為 MSG Rangers，兩邊代號與細節請以最終公告為準。分拆股常因被動賣壓與分析師覆蓋不足被忽視，這是雷達邏輯；風險是仍需聯盟與稅務事項、控股家族的治理折價。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: MSG Sports is spinning off its Rangers business; per an 8-K the distribution is expected to complete Oct. 26, with when-issued trading from Oct. 21 and regular-way trading expected Oct. 27. The remaining MSG Sports is to be renamed MSG Knicks and the new company is MSG Rangers; confirm tickers and details against final announcements. Spin-offs are often neglected through passive selling and thin coverage, which is the radar logic; risks include league and tax matters and a governance discount from the controlling family. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

stocks.n: MSG Sports，將改名並留下尼克隊業務
MSG Rangers，分拆新公司

status: RADAR · 下一個驗證點 10/27 正式交易

tag: Versigent（VGNT）：回購與股利明確，但「被忽視」已不成立
zh: Versigent 是 Aptiv 4 月分拆出的汽車電子與電氣架構公司，帶 21 億美元債務、2.5 億美元回購計畫與股利政策。UBS 與高盛都以買進評等啟動覆蓋，最近一份資料顯示 11 個買進、2 個持有、1 個賣出，Zacks 則在 10/17 降到強力賣出。覆蓋不再稀少，所以它已不太符合「雙重忽視」；列在這裡是為了追蹤分拆股被重新定價的過程。風險：汽車景氣與負債。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Versigent is the automotive electronics and electrical architecture business Aptiv spun off in April, carrying $2.1 billion of debt, a $250 million buyback and a dividend policy. UBS and Goldman both initiated with Buy ratings, and the latest data show 11 Buys, 2 Holds and 1 Sell, while Zacks cut it to Strong Sell on Oct. 17. Coverage is no longer thin, so it no longer fits double neglect well; it stays here to track how a spin-off gets repriced. Risks: auto cycle and leverage. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

stocks.n: Versigent，Aptiv 分拆，買進評等為多數
Aptiv，母公司對照

tag: Inhibrx（INBX）：執行長 10/14 再度買進約 85 萬美元
zh: 生技公司 Inhibrx 的創辦人兼執行長 Mark Lappe 在 10/14 透過信託買進約 85 萬美元股票；9 月初他才以約每股 105.82 美元買進 25,000 股、約 260 萬美元，另有兩位董事同日買進。股價從 9 月約 114 美元回落到 10 月 10 日約 85.68 美元，也就是他在更低的價位又買了一次。判讀提醒：生技股的風險主要是臨床結果，內部人買進不能取代數據。
en: Inhibrx founder and CEO Mark Lappe bought about $850,000 of stock through trusts on Oct. 14; in early September he had bought 25,000 shares at about $105.82, roughly $2.6 million, alongside two directors. The stock slid from about $114 in September to about $85.68 on Oct. 10, so he bought again at a lower price. A caution: biotech risk is mostly clinical results, and insider buying cannot replace data.

stocks.n: Inhibrx，執行長信託買進約 85 萬美元

tag: New Era Energy & Digital（NUAI）：10% 股東兼董事買進 119 萬美元
zh: 董事兼 10% 股東 Kent McCarthy 在 10/9 以約每股 4.77 美元買進 25 萬股，約 119 萬美元。之後 NUAI 在 10/17 單日上漲約 44%，並宣布終止股權購買安排、撤回增加授權股數與反向分割的提案。判讀提醒：股價兩週內已大漲，買進發生在上漲之前，但追高風險與董事會經驗不足的評論都要列入考慮。
en: Director and 10% holder Kent McCarthy bought 250,000 shares on Oct. 9 at about $4.77, roughly $1.19 million. NUAI then rose about 44% in one day on Oct. 17, ended its equity purchase facility and withdrew proposals for more authorized shares and a reverse split. A caution: the stock has already surged in two weeks; the purchase came before the rise, but chasing risk and comments about an inexperienced board both belong in the picture.

stocks.n: New Era Energy & Digital，董事兼 10% 股東買進

tag: 判讀：10% 持有人與基金買進，不等於經營者買進
zh: Form 4 上的買方不一定是經營團隊。Saba Capital 在 10/16 至 10/19 於四檔封閉式基金（DSM、JOF、ECF、GF）合計買進約 119 萬美元，它是持有人而不是管理這些基金的人；Nippon Life 以董事兼 10% 股東身分買進 Corebridge 約 1,200 萬美元，則是策略性股東。看到大金額先分清楚：是經營者拿薪水之外的錢買進，還是機構的持股策略。
en: The buyer on a Form 4 is not always management. Saba Capital bought about $1.19 million across four closed-end funds (DSM, JOF, ECF, GF) from Oct. 16 to 19 as a holder, not as the people running those funds, and Nippon Life bought about $12 million of Corebridge as a director and 10% holder, a strategic shareholder. With a large amount, first separate operators spending their own money from an institution's holding strategy.

stocks.n: Corebridge，Nippon Life 董事兼 10% 股東買進約 1,200 萬美元
Ellsworth Growth & Income，Saba 持續買進

tag: David Taylor 申報買進 Fifth Third、RPM、AT&T
zh: 眾議員 David Taylor 在 10/16 申報的交易中，買進 Fifth Third（FITB）、RPM、AT&T，賣出 P&G。這組持股偏向區域銀行、塗料與電信的收息價值族群，賣掉的是消費必需品，單看結構像是在調整價值與利率敏感度的搭配。申報頁面沒有顯示金額與交易日，細節請查眾議院書記官原文。這是誰申報了什麼，不是買賣訊號。
en: In a filing dated Oct. 16, Rep. David Taylor reported buying Fifth Third (FITB), RPM and AT&T and selling P&G. The basket leans toward regional banking, coatings and telecom value and income names, while the sale was a consumer staple; structurally it reads like a rebalance of value and rate sensitivity. The summary page shows no amounts or transaction dates, so check the House Clerk original. This reports who filed what; it is not a trading signal.

stocks.n: Fifth Third，區域銀行，申報買進
RPM，塗料與建材化學，申報買進
AT&T，申報買進；週三股價約 -6.45%

tag: 判讀：申報延遲讓價位對不上
zh: 政要申報最多可晚 45 天，所以申報的 AT&T 買進發生在週三下跌約 6.45% 之前，跟單者買到的是別人幾週前的價位。Jonathan Jackson 在 10/20 的單次申報裡同時有買進（GH、DDOG、EL）與賣出（TYG、VSAT、WMT），方向互相抵銷，更難讀出單一主題。金額只有寬區間，多數也是配偶或信託帳戶執行。這是資訊來源，不是買賣訊號。
en: Filings can be up to 45 days late, so the AT&T purchase came before Wednesday's drop of about 6.45%; anyone following buys at prices set weeks earlier. A single Oct. 20 filing by Jonathan Jackson contains both purchases (GH, DDOG, EL) and sales (TYG, VSAT, WMT), which offset each other and make a single theme hard to read. Amounts are only wide ranges and many trades are made by spouses or trusts. This is a source of information, not a trading signal.

stocks.n: Guardant Health，Jackson 申報買進
Datadog，Jackson 申報買進；週三約 +6.5%
Estée Lauder，Jackson 申報買進

tag: 總經：10/28 FOMC，隨後 GDP 與 PCE
zh: 未來幾個交易日的總經重點：10/28（週三）下午 2 點（美東）FOMC 利率決策；之後預計公布第三季 GDP 初值與 9 月 PCE 物價指數，有來源列為 10/29，也有來源列為 10/30，確切日期請以經濟分析局公告為準。在殖利率高於 5% 的背景下，PCE 的細項比標題數字更重要。
en: Macro focus for the coming sessions: the FOMC decision at 2 p.m. ET on Wednesday Oct. 28; then third-quarter GDP (advance) and September PCE inflation, which one source lists for Oct. 29 and another for Oct. 30, so confirm the date with the Bureau of Economic Analysis. With yields above 5%, PCE components matter more than the headline.

stocks.n: 標普 500 ETF，FOMC 與 PCE 前後的整體風向
長天期公債 ETF，對 FOMC 與 PCE 最敏感

tag: 財報：週四一早鐵路、國防、消費，下週 MSFT 與 GOOGL
zh: 週四（10/22）盤前：Honeywell、洛克希德馬丁、聯合太平洋鐵路、諾福克南方鐵路、寶僑、康卡斯特、Valero、黑石等；盤後：Western Digital、Deckers、Newmont、Bloom Energy 等。下週重點：10/28 盤後有微軟與 Alphabet，10/29 盤後有亞馬遜，蘋果預計 11/2。鐵路兩家同天公布，貨運量與燃料成本可以互相對照。

Next week: Microsoft and Alphabet report after the close on Oct. 28, Amazon on Oct. 29 and Apple is expected Nov. 2. The two railroads report the same morning, so freight volumes and fuel costs can be cross-checked.

tag: AI 基礎設施在漲，但小型股和消費沒跟上
zh: 今天最值得注意的一件事：週三那斯達克 100 漲約 1.13%，羅素 2000 只漲約 0.16%，AT&T、Chipotle、惠而浦、Netflix 同時下跌，十年期殖利率仍在 5.1% 以上。盤後 Meta、IBM 上漲、Lam Research 反而下跌，市場獎勵的是看得見的 AI 需求，而不是單純的財報優於預期。接下來的檢驗是 10/28 的 FOMC 與微軟、Alphabet 財報。
en: The one thing to note today: on Wednesday the Nasdaq 100 gained about 1.13% against about 0.16% for the Russell 2000, while AT&T, Chipotle, Whirlpool and Netflix fell and the 10-year yield stayed above 5.1%. After hours Meta and IBM rose while Lam Research fell, so the market is rewarding visible AI demand rather than simple earnings beats. The next tests are the Oct. 28 FOMC and the Microsoft and Alphabet reports.

stocks.n: Meta，盤後約 +4%
Lam Research，優於預期仍約 -6%
羅素 2000 ETF，小型股落後
